desc_en: Updating parameters at inference: test-time training and fast weights for LLMs, test-time RL, world models and online continual adaptation.
trend_en: Share up nearly 10× (3.5 → 33.0): TTT went from a branch of vision TTA to an inference-time learning paradigm for LLMs (in-place TTT, fast weights, test-time RL).

desc_en: Classic TTA: entropy minimisation, whitening, continual TTA, and test-time prompt and feature adaptation for VLMs such as CLIP.
trend_en: Stable (28.8 → 28.6); new questions are when TTA fails (failure prediction, gain gating) and poisoning attacks against TTA.

desc_en: LLM agents that accumulate experience, skills and memory from past trajectories to keep self-evolving without weight updates.
trend_en: Share grew about 9× (5.6 → 50.7), the largest increase in this group: agent memory systems boomed, and critiques have already appeared ("more experience makes agents worse", "is a predefined optimisation pipeline still needed?").

desc_en: Theory and mechanisms of in-context learning in Transformers: ICL for linear regression, training dynamics, multi-head specialisation and algorithmic implementations.
trend_en: Share halved 23.2 → 10.7: linear-regression ICL theory is saturating, with moves to attention-versus-SSM comparisons, HMM prediction and ICL in closed-loop interaction.

desc_en: Function and tool calling by LLM agents, MCP server benchmarks, tool selection and training tool-integrated reasoning.
trend_en: Stable (31.8 → 31.9); moving from building MCP benchmarks to silent tool failures, probing tool outputs and credit assignment at the level of tool calls.

desc_en: Learning latent world models with joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPA) for planning, MPC and representation learning, studying collapse and representation geometry.
trend_en: Share 1.0 → 47.4, a jump from 2 papers to 204: V-JEPA 2 and LeJEPA (isotropic Gaussian regularisation) drove the latent-space planning line, with many papers on representation geometry and collapse prevention.

desc_en: KV cache reuse in LLM serving: prefix and non-prefix caching, cross-model sharing, migration and storage-tier management.
trend_en: Share up 3.5× (11.1 → 39.5): multi-turn and multi-agent workloads made KV reuse central, with non-prefix reuse, sharing across model families and SSD-level cache management.

desc_en: Unsupervised and source-free domain adaptation: feature alignment, adversarial and contrastive learning, including graph domain adaptation and open-set adaptation.
trend_en: Share nearly halved 41.9 → 23.5: foundation models reduce the need for classic UDA, and the remaining activity is in graph domain adaptation and open-set cross-network node classification.

desc_en: Evaluation methods and domain benchmarks for LLMs and VLMs: psychometrics and IRT, text-evaluation metrics, and vertical evaluations such as creative writing and education.
trend_en: Share down 42.4 → 31.9: general evaluation methodology was diluted by vertical-domain benchmarks (screenplays, creativity, education, scientific figures), and large-scale behavioural studies in a "science of capabilities" style appeared.

desc_en: Learning nonlinear and chaotic dynamical systems from data: Koopman operators, neural ODEs, switching linear systems and neural population dynamics.
trend_en: Stable (31.8 → 33.5); prominent directions are statistically faithful training on chaotic systems, reconstructing neural dynamics with switching state-space models, and identifiability guarantees.

desc_en: Black-box optimisation with Gaussian-process surrogates: acquisition functions, high-dimensional BO, hyperparameter optimisation and experimental design.
trend_en: Share down 32.3 → 23.9; two main lines: LLMs entering the BO loop (priors, in-context compilation, calibrated acquisition choice) and re-examining whether vanilla BO works in high dimensions after all.

desc_en: Alignment from human preferences: RLHF, DPO and its variants, pluralistic preference alignment and preference optimisation for diffusion models.
trend_en: Share fell to a quarter 42.9 → 10.5: the DPO-variant wave is over, replaced by RLVR and rubric rewards; remaining work turns to preference alignment for text-to-image and pluralistic alignment.

desc_en: Physical plausibility, controllability and evaluation benchmarks for text-to-video generation, plus multi-agent video generation pipelines.
trend_en: Share up 29.8 → 34.2: physical consistency moved from "can we tell" to distilling physical knowledge and diagnosing blind spots in physical attributes, and agentic video production appeared.

desc_en: MLLMs for real-time video streams: online memory, token pruning, proactive responses and always-on egocentric assistants.
trend_en: Share up 4× (7.1 → 31.2): moving from offline long-video QA to always-on assistants, with emphasis on persistent memory across sessions, when to respond proactively and causal token pruning.

desc_en: Attributing model behaviour to training examples with influence functions and related methods, for data valuation, data selection and behaviour diagnosis.
trend_en: Share down slightly 19.2 → 15.1; methods move toward exact attribution (MAGIC) and clarifying the counterfactual setting, and are applied to locating and controlling emergent misalignment.

desc_en: An umbrella cluster sharing the word "agentic": automatic design and configuration of agent workflows, runtime auditing and agent applications in vertical domains.
trend_en: Share up 27.3 → 44.4: "agentic" became a generic selling point, and work moved from hand-built workflows to automatically configuring and redesigning agent systems, with new attention to energy use and auditability.

desc_en: Segmentation of CT, MRI and other medical images: semi-supervised and few-shot segmentation, SAM/SAM2 adaptation and Mamba/U-Net architecture tweaks.
trend_en: Stable (29.3 → 26.5); SAM2 auto-prompting and semi-supervised consistency are now standard, and growth is mostly cross-domain few-shot and sparse-annotation work.

desc_en: Training-free acceleration of diffusion Transformers, especially video DiTs: feature and timestep caching, sparse attention and linear attention.
trend_en: Share up slightly 21.7 → 24.4: caching moved from fixed intervals to error-controlled and solver-aware schemes, and is starting to target few-step distilled models and reuse across requests.

desc_en: Multi-objective optimisation, Pareto-set learning and multi-objective RL, applied to molecular design, diffusion models and multi-objective LLM alignment.
trend_en: Stable (23.7 → 24.9); novelty lies in better scalarisation for Pareto-set learning and applying Pareto fronts to diffusion models and LLM arena evaluation.

desc_en: Neural simulation of fluids, fracture, elastic and rigid bodies, and identifying physical parameters from video, for simulation and world models.
trend_en: Share up 29.8 → 39.1: merging with world models and physics-aware video generation, with work on identifying physical properties from video, differentiable coupled simulation and "simulate first, then generate video".

desc_en: Theory of Markov decision processes: POMDPs, constrained MDPs, state abstraction, regret bounds and sample complexity.
trend_en: Share diluted 25.7 → 18.8: classic RL theory grows far more slowly than total submissions, and topics are getting narrower (terminal states, average-reward CMDPs, causal MDPs).

desc_en: Post-training quantization of LLMs and VLMs: extremely low-bit weight quantization, mixed precision, Hessian-based error compensation and MoE quantization.
trend_en: Share up 34.8 → 50.7 and counts tripled: competition centres on 2-bit and below, backprop-free mixed precision and MoE bit allocation, and privacy-leakage analysis of quantization has appeared.

desc_en: General work on LLM mathematical and logical reasoning: reasoning benchmarks, robustness tests, self-critique and data synthesis.
trend_en: Share fell to about 1/4 (95.4 → 26.7): generic "improve LLM reasoning" papers were absorbed by dedicated clusters such as RLVR, test-time scaling and agents, leaving robustness benchmarks and analysis of self-verification.

desc_en: Adversarial attacks and defences: black-box transfer attacks, universal perturbations, physical-world attacks and adversarial attacks on VLMs.
trend_en: Share nearly halved 59.6 → 32.1: transfer attacks on classifiers show diminishing returns, and targets moved to infrared and remote-sensing VLMs, personalised generation and image-quality-assessment models.

desc_en: 2D and 3D object detection: open-vocabulary and open-world detection, small objects, camouflage, and specific settings such as SAR, underwater and low-altitude imagery.
trend_en: Share down 43.4 → 33.0: improvements to general detectors are rare; growth is mostly in vertical settings such as low-altitude RGB-IR, SAR and underwater, and in open-world objectness.

desc_en: Protein language models and structure representation learning: function and mutation-effect prediction, binding affinity and RNA structure.
trend_en: Share down slightly 37.3 → 31.4; work is moving to variant-effect and epistasis prediction and conformational-ensemble representations, and adopting JEPA-style latent pretraining.

desc_en: Exploration in non-LLM RL: intrinsic rewards, novelty, empowerment, sparse rewards and GFlowNet exploration.
trend_en: Share down 22.2 → 13.5: classic exploration research is shrinking as the topic migrates to the LLM-RL clusters (entropy, diversity); only a little work here measures exploration by LM agents.

desc_en: Online convex optimisation and regret analysis under bandit feedback, applied to market making, bilateral trade, autobidding, congestion routing and other economics and OR settings.
trend_en: Share recovered 14.1 → 24.9: 2027 leans toward market mechanisms (limit-order-book market making, bilateral trade with one-bit feedback, autobidding in first-price auctions), with new OCO settings such as delayed feedback and warm starts.

desc_en: Deep-research agents that retrieve, read and write reports over many steps, and benchmarks of their report quality, evidence coverage and synthesis.
trend_en: Share halved 25.7 → 11.9 (paper count flat 51 → 51): the 2026 wave of general DR benchmarks (DeepResearch Bench, BrowseComp-Plus) has passed, and 2027 turns to vertical and professional settings (Wiki Live, everyday scenarios, video DR, biomedicine) and diagnosing post-retrieval synthesis.

desc_en: Evidence filtering, sufficiency judgement, multi-hop evidence assembly and context compression in RAG, plus defences against RAG poisoning.
trend_en: Share 0.5 → 30.2, appearing from nothing: RAG itself is not new; rather, 2027 papers widely use "evidence" as their core term (evidence-assembly gaps, evidence sufficiency, budgeted selection), so this work forms its own cluster; part of this is down to wording style.

desc_en: LoRA and its variants (rank growth, manifold optimisation, normalisation, routing and composition), adapter placement and other parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods, including federated LoRA.
trend_en: Share keeps falling 76.3 → 63.1 → 47.2: LoRA improvements have hit diminishing returns, and 2027 novelty centres on raising effective rank (Boosting, RBF nonlinearity), geometric optimisation and instance-level LoRA generation.

desc_en: LLM weight compression and delta compression mainly via SVD and tensor decomposition, mixed with learned image and video codecs and lossless compression.
trend_en: Share down 43.9 → 31.6: SVD-style LLM compression is still the mainstay but saturating, and 2027 turns to checkpoints "trained for truncation" and generation-aware SVD; learned image compression now stresses practical CPU deployment.

desc_en: Spectral and orthogonalising optimizers led by Muon: Newton–Schulz iterations, comparisons with Adam, convergence analysis and scaling to LLM and DiT pretraining.
trend_en: Share more than doubled 15.1 → 37.4: after Kimi and others adopted Muon in large-scale pretraining it became the default object of study, and 2027 moves from speeding up Muon to explaining why it beats Adam (spectral allocation, smoothing effects) and to tensorised and curvature-enhanced variants.

desc_en: Predicting spatial gene expression from H&E pathology slides, pretraining representations of spatial omics, super-resolution and decontamination, linking computational pathology and single-cell omics.
trend_en: Share up 11.1 → 17.2: the task moved from spot-level regression to single-cell-resolution prediction and "field reconstruction" modelling, with agents that curate large public spatial-omics data using single-cell references.

desc_en: Target-structure-based molecule generation, virtual screening, docking and molecular optimisation, including PROTAC, peptide and fragment-based drug design.
trend_en: Share down 26.8 → 18.1: pure pocket-conditioned generation is fading; 2027 brings more billion-scale screening, SBDD foundation models, LLM-guided medicinal-chemistry knowledge and molecular-optimisation agents.

desc_en: Group-relative advantage estimation, reward reweighting, use of failed samples and stability improvements around GRPO, for maths reasoning and multi-reward post-training.
trend_en: Share down 54.0 → 42.1: the burst of GRPO variants triggered by DeepSeek-R1 has peaked; 2027 focuses on details such as sparse success, multi-reward saturation and using failure signals, and spills over to non-maths tasks such as regression, drug design and agent derivation.

desc_en: D4RL-style offline RL: conservative value estimation, policy extraction, trajectory stitching, offline-to-online fine-tuning and goal-conditioned RL.
trend_en: Share keeps halving 85.7 → 60.1 → 33.0: classic offline RL researchers are moving to LLM-RL and embodied work, and the 2027 remainder is mostly simplification (one-step policy improvement, planning instead of tuning) and diffusion and flow policy extraction.

desc_en: Activation functions, initialisation, spectral bias and regularisation of INRs and neural fields, for representing and compressing images, medical and neuroimaging signals, and weight-space learning.
trend_en: Share down 24.2 → 13.9: INRs are squeezed by 3DGS and feed-forward reconstruction; 2027 is dominated by initialisation and sampling theory and niche applications such as neuroimaging, with some moving to explicit 2D Gaussian fields.

desc_en: Dynamic and block-sparse attention, cross-layer shared indices and KV selection for long-context prefill and decoding, also used to speed up diffusion language models.
trend_en: Share up 23.2 → 33.2: trainable sparse attention in the style of DeepSeek NSA/DSA and the lightning indexer spurred work on indexer design (cross-layer shared routing, head-routing indices), extending to dLLM acceleration.

desc_en: Dictionary learning that decomposes LLM activations with SAEs and transcoders: feature absorption, dead neurons, seed dependence, hierarchical SAEs and evaluating explanations.
trend_en: Stable (33.8 → 32.5): moving from proposing new SAE architectures to diagnosing reliability (seed instability, fixing absorption, reporting standards for ablation scores) and comparisons with transcoders.

desc_en: Testing internal mechanisms of LLMs and VLMs with activation patching, causal interventions and representation geometry, and questioning the identifiability of the intervention methods themselves.
trend_en: Share 2.5 → 62.3, an explosive new cluster (268 papers): mechanistic interpretability expanded from circuit discovery into a widely used "causal testing" paradigm; many 2027 papers argue that intervention ≠ identification and discuss failures of component ranking, making methodological self-scrutiny the main line.

desc_en: Classic classification settings: generalised category discovery (GCD), open-set recognition, long-tail and class-imbalanced semi-supervised learning, and few-shot classification.
trend_en: Share down 32.8 → 22.1: traditional CV classification settings keep fading; the main 2027 novelty is category-discovery loops verified or guided by LLMs.

desc_en: OOD detection scores, training regularisers and theory for image classifiers and VLMs, covering multi-label, graph, LiDAR and federated settings.
trend_en: Share halved twice 53.1 → 28.8 → 13.3: OOD detection is shrinking as a standalone direction; the 2027 remainder leans toward tuning without OOD data, density-ratio theory and CLIP negative labels.

desc_en: Distilling diffusion and flow models into one- or few-step generators: distribution matching distillation (DMD), adversarial distillation and score distillation, for images and video.
trend_en: Share recovered 15.1 → 22.6: the DMD family became mainstream; 2027 borrows on-policy distillation and reward tilting from LLMs, and focuses on preserving diversity and distilling video diffusion.

desc_en: Locating and explaining attention heads with specific functions in LLMs and VLMs (retrieval heads, in-context learning heads, attention sinks), and using them for steering and reranking.
trend_en: Share up slightly 14.6 → 19.1: moving from discovering one type of functional head to systematic censuses of functional heads and causal head selection, and using such heads directly to analyse persuasion mechanisms and train rerankers.

desc_en: A mixed cluster grouped by the word "decision": auditing beliefs and decisions of LLM agents, decision-focused learning, decision-tree learning and even vehicle dispatch.
trend_en: Share up 23.7 → 40.2: growth comes mainly from decision-theoretic audits of LLM agents (belief-behaviour consistency, diagnosing evidence gathering), not from one methodological paradigm.

desc_en: Robot manipulation learning: bimanual, dexterous and deformable-object manipulation, imitation learning and VLA policies, latent actions, and many simulated and real-robot benchmarks.
trend_en: Share up 42.4 → 48.6: 2027 brings a dense wave of manipulation benchmarks (bimanual, industrial constraints, biology labs, cloth, memory, value models), and low-cost reproducible hardware platforms are starting to reach ICLR.

desc_en: MeZO-style zeroth-order optimisation, low-rank optimizer states and subspace gradient methods for fine-tuning and training LLMs under tight GPU memory.
trend_en: Share down 20.7 → 11.4: interest in zeroth-order fine-tuning has faded, and 2027 work refines ternary and sparse perturbations, edge fine-tuning for BitNet and subspace maintenance.

desc_en: Visual autoregressive generation such as VAR and MAR, its 1D and 2D visual tokenizers, generation order and high-resolution acceleration.
trend_en: Share fell sharply 41.9 → 13.9: the 2026 VAR/MAR wave was absorbed by unified multimodal models and diffusion, and the 2027 remainder centres on tokenizer structure (nested, quadtree, hybrid 1D+2D).

desc_en: Understanding and reasoning in large audio-language models, spatial audio and long audio, plus text- and video-to-audio and music generation.
trend_en: Roughly stable (42.9 → 38.1): evaluation takes a larger share in 2027, focused on long-duration audio understanding, spatial auditory scenes and source alignment in multi-shot audio-visual generation.

desc_en: Anomaly detection in industrial vision, video, graphs, time series and tabular data, especially CLIP-based zero- and few-shot anomaly detection.
trend_en: Share up 51.5 → 60.4: zero-shot industrial anomaly detection with CLIP is the main battleground, and 2027 adds statistical angles such as diagnosing "definition blind spots" in open-world video anomalies and Type I error guarantees.

desc_en: LLM serving: scheduling, prefill-decode disaggregation, parallelism and communication overlap, and privacy-preserving inference under homomorphic encryption and MPC.
trend_en: Stable (36.3 → 35.6): 2027 pays more attention to bottleneck scheduling in disaggregated serving, geo-distributed deployment and queueing-theory analysis, and HE/MPC private inference is getting cost simulators and benchmarks.

desc_en: Long-video QA, keyframe selection, video memory and multi-turn reasoning in multimodal LLMs, plus many video-understanding benchmarks.
trend_en: Stable, slightly up (42.4 → 45.1): after the 2026 multi-turn RL frame-selection methods, 2027 is mostly benchmarks that target harder settings such as very long series, panoramic video, multi-stream audio-visual input and incomplete observations.

desc_en: Decomposing epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty, evidential deep learning, ensembles and Bayesian methods, and uncertainty estimation for LLMs and agents.
trend_en: Roughly stable (55.0 → 49.3): the target moved from classifiers to chained LLM actions and agent memory, alongside ground-truth evaluation frameworks for uncertainty decomposition.

desc_en: Training, compression and geometric analysis of sentence and text embedding models, Matryoshka embeddings, embedding translation and similarity measures.
trend_en: Share down 36.3 → 22.3: some retrieval work moved to the retrieval cluster (292), leaving a scattered set of analyses of embedding-space geometry and compression.

desc_en: Compositional zero-shot learning (attribute-object), mechanisms of systematic and compositional generalisation in Transformers, and neuroscience-inspired representation recombination.
trend_en: Stable (19.7 → 20.5): 2027 adds work on how task composition affects generalisation and compositionality in self-improvement, while CZSL methods still make up half.

desc_en: Byzantine-robust aggregation, gradient inversion and data leakage, and homomorphic-encryption and differential-privacy protection in federated learning.
trend_en: Share down 25.2 → 14.4: classic FL security is fading; the new 2027 angle is leakage auditing and membership inference for federated LLMs, RLHF and diffusion models.

desc_en: Data synthesis, mid-training, test-time training, context compression and long-context reasoning benchmarks for long-context LLMs.
trend_en: Share fell then levelled 54.0 → 24.2 → 20.9: window extension is largely solved, and 2027 focuses on characterising long-context reasoning difficulty, measuring the attention span data requires and mid-training on agent trajectories.

desc_en: VLM-based GUI, mobile and computer-use agents: grounding interface elements, online RL training, memory and long-horizon task planning.
trend_en: Share up 30.3 → 34.4: 2026 centred on base GUI models plus online RL, while 2027 starts to bypass pixel-level operation (deeplinks, CLI-style interfaces, "do agents need a screen?") and introduces GUI world models based on image generation.

desc_en: Optimising and automatically evolving the harness around LLM agents (prompts, tools, memory, control flow) so that agents rewrite their own scaffolding from failures.
trend_en: Share 0 → 0 → 53.0, entirely new (228 papers): after Claude Code and Codex-style coding agents spread, the "harness" replaced the prompt or workflow as the object of optimisation, and self-evolving harnesses and gain attribution became one of the main agent lines of 2027.

desc_en: Referring expression segmentation, video object segmentation, SAM-family promptable segmentation and 3D/4D instance segmentation.
trend_en: Share down 37.3 → 28.8: general segmentation is converging after the release of SAM 3, and 2027 turns to niches such as streaming 3D/4D segmentation and decoupling referring evidence from boundaries.

desc_en: AI control protocols for frontier models, LLM monitors, scalable oversight and debate, sabotage and deception evaluations, and safety position papers.
trend_en: Stable (37.3 → 37.4): the focus moved from evaluating deception and observer effects to monitoring agent workflows, detecting sabotage in automated AI R&D and cryptographic guarantees for debate.

desc_en: Expressivity (WL tests), heterophily, over-smoothing, graph rewiring, and node classification and link prediction for message-passing GNNs.
trend_en: Share halved twice 180.8 → 95.9 → 54.6: GNNs, long a staple of ICLR, keep giving way to LLM topics, and 2027 leans toward reflective work on expressivity theory and the statistical resolution of benchmarks.

desc_en: Compressing large datasets into a few synthetic samples (gradient and distribution matching, diffusion-based generative distillation) and coreset selection.
trend_en: Share fell sharply 19.7 → 7.2: less attractive in the foundation-model era; 2027 work centres on parameterisations (codebooks, masks), multimodal distillation and reuse across budgets.

desc_en: Erasing unsafe or copyrighted concepts and styles from text-to-image diffusion models while preserving other abilities and resisting adversarial prompts.
trend_en: Share down 18.7 → 12.8: methods have become homogeneous; 2027 turns to cross-attention sparsity and erasure that is robust in subspaces and to initial noise, and extends to image-to-video.

desc_en: Subgraph explainers, counterfactual explanations, Shapley attribution and self-explaining GNNs, and evaluation of their faithfulness.
trend_en: Share fell sharply 16.2 → 6.3: as GNNs shrink overall, the 2027 remainder leans toward theory (complexity of explanation) and evaluation (compilable benchmarks, intervention-aware faithfulness).

desc_en: Learning robustly with noisy labels, partial-label, multi-label and label-distribution learning, weak supervision and detecting annotation errors.
trend_en: Share down 29.3 → 21.6: classic noisy-label methods are fading; the new 2027 angle is detecting errors in LLM-annotated data and statistical guarantees for human-in-the-loop correction.

desc_en: Entropic, unbalanced and sliced OT, Wasserstein distances, Monge maps and Gromov–Wasserstein, with applications to generation and matching.
trend_en: Roughly stable (42.4 → 40.0): 2027 leans toward algorithms and theory (an O(NlogN) algorithm for partial OT on the circle, stability of Monge maps), with continued overlap with flow matching.

desc_en: Novel view synthesis from sparse views or a single image: multi-view diffusion, video diffusion priors, feed-forward reconstruction and rendering.
trend_en: Share down 24.7 → 16.0: per-scene optimisation NVS was drawn off by feed-forward 3D reconstruction and world models, and 2027 mainly turns video diffusion models into multi-view generators.

desc_en: Dense and multi-vector retrieval, visual document retrieval, composed image retrieval and LLM reranking, studying embeddings, late interaction and efficient encoding.
trend_en: Share up 37.3 → 56.7: demand from RAG and agentic search is reviving retrieval, and 2027 centres on multi-vector compression (FDE), visual document retrieval and low-cost LLM reranking of long lists.

desc_en: Building networks, kernels and generative models on Riemannian manifolds such as SPD, Grassmann and hyperbolic spaces, and testing the manifold hypothesis.
trend_en: Share down slightly 25.2 → 20.5: the topic is stable, and 2027 adds flow and bridge generative models on manifolds (Riemannian MeanFlow, Schrödinger bridges) and challenges to the manifold hypothesis.

desc_en: Neural architecture search: zero-cost proxies, multi-objective and hardware-aware NAS, and LLM-driven evolutionary architecture discovery.
trend_en: Share down 11.1 → 7.0: traditional NAS keeps drifting to the margins, and nearly all remaining work now uses LLMs as evolutionary proposers or agents to search architectures.

desc_en: Basic architectural changes and theory for Transformers: layer, depth and width shape, alternatives to residuals and normalisation, and expressivity of head count.
trend_en: Share keeps falling 55.7 → 36.8 → 24.2: general architecture changes were drawn into finer clusters such as sparse attention and positional encoding, and 2027 work is mostly small changes such as shape conventions, variable width and LayerNorm replacements.

desc_en: Longitudinal clinical prediction from electronic health records, disease-progression modelling, EHR foundation models and benchmarks of LLM clinical reasoning.
trend_en: Share up markedly 23.2 → 38.6: growth comes from promptable EHR foundation models, physician-validated synthetic longitudinal EHR benchmarks, and RL and agent skill evolution for treatment planning.

desc_en: Frequency analysis of RoPE, length extrapolation, data-aware and gated positional encodings, and multi-dimensional positional encodings for video diffusion and similar settings.
trend_en: Stable (22.7 → 20.0): 2027 brings critical theory such as "RoPE provably fails at long context" and RoPE alternatives, extending to compressed tokens and video DiTs.

desc_en: Point cloud registration, completion, denoising, segmentation and representation learning, including cross-source and image-to-point-cloud registration and CAD reconstruction.
trend_en: Share down slightly 28.3 → 24.6: registration remains the core, and 2027 brings registration recast as 3D reconstruction, frequency-domain representations and generative CAD/B-Rep construction.

desc_en: Cooperative MARL: value decomposition, communication, decentralised training, zero-shot coordination and robustness.
trend_en: Share down 46.4 → 34.9: classic SMAC-style value decomposition is fading, and 2027 focuses on decentralised modelling, the cost of communication delay and LLM-era techniques such as on-policy distillation.
